about_the_game:
In Scare Crow, you will unleash your inner prankster by playing as Casey the Crow, who is feuding with squirrels over their limited food source. In a blend of stealth and 3rd person tower defense gameplay, you will hide and set traps to jump-scare your skittish enemies and send them fleeing your territory in fear.

Traps 

Prevent invading squirrels from reaching your food using beehives, sandboxes, and other items. Set them up around the backyard, lure those pesky squirrels in, and watch them deal with the hilarious consequences.

 Lures

Squirrels love acorns! And their love is a weakness you can use against them… Throw acorns in strategic spots to distract squirrels and lure them into traps before they steal your food. 

Fly

Flap your wings to fly around the yard and get a literal bird’s eye view of your enemy. Observe their movements and swoop down from above at just the right moment to scare the crap out of them. Or use your wings to quickly chase down squirrels that have avoided your traps.
